dedupe_keys.name: data accompanying the research on reservoir operation for the pong and bhakra reservoir in northern india

description: Quan Dau and Adebayo Adeloye at Heriot-Watt University publish operating data covering the Pong and Bhakra reservoirs in northern India. The dataset contains release time series, including spills, evaporation losses and reservoir rule curves. Zenodo lists data.zip in the March 2021 deposit, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The brief description leaves the observation period, timestep, measurement units, curve definitions and internal file formats unknown. A modeller could use releases and evaporation losses to check water-balance simulations, and rule curves to compare operating policies once the archive documentation is examined. These inputs describe two named reservoirs and do not by themselves establish a complete basin model or all inflow conditions. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The files were not downloaded or numerically checked.
